title: AstraZeneca bulks up MASH, cardio work in up to $1.5B AI partnership with insitro
snippet: AstraZeneca will tap AI-focused insitro to find new targets for metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis and cardiomyopathies, following the Phase 3 failure of its Ionis-partnered Wainua in transthyretin-mediated amyloid cardiomyopathy.

title: Webinar: The China question: Can US biotechs lead as investment heads east?
snippet: In this webinar, BioSpace will gathered experts to discuss China’s impact on the future of biotech and how both U.S. and Chinese companies can thrive—and maybe even collaborate.

title: GSK laying off 1.2K+ in Belgium
snippet: Follow along as BioSpace tracks job cuts and restructuring initiatives.

title: FDA's latest rare disease framework seeks to prioritize consistency in flexibility
snippet: Following several recent initiatives, the FDA's newest rare disease framework sets out to standardize the agency's approach to scientific evidence and bring rare disease therapies to patients faster.

title: Stoffels strikes up new biotech in return to Galapagos cell therapy mission
snippet: A new biotech co-founded by Paul Stoffels has formed to take on the CAR T cell assets of Galapagos almost a year after the company—now known as Lakefront Biotherapeutics—abandoned them.

title: Arrowhead’s blood-brain barrier tech is ‘arguably better’ than others, analysts say after data drop
snippet: Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals’ siRNA candidate achieved “compelling” tau reductions in an early study of healthy volunteers, with a magnitude of effect that seems to outperformother blood-brain barrier platforms, according to Stifel.

title: Vanda freezes Novartis-originated social anxiety program after late-stage disappointment
snippet: While Oppenheimer doesn’t see the Phase 3 stumble of VQW-765 as highly detrimental to Vanda Pharmaceuticals, the analyst nevertheless believes the stakes are now higher for the company’s planned Q4 readout for Nereus in GLP-1-induced vomiting.
